native.ip_version: Explicit selected IPv4 or IPv6; no automatic industry/IP family selection.
native.ip_role: Actual source, destination or forwarding node; IPv6 routers never initiate IP fragmentation.
native.ip_packet_kind: Actual whole packet versus one fragment; reassembled upper payload is not current fragment length.
native.ip_destination_kind: Actual unicast/multicast/IPv4 broadcast; IPv6 has no broadcast.
native.ip_lower_path_kind: Actual registered lower bearer; Ethernet is one option, not an IP requirement.
native.ip_payload_mode: IPv6 normal16-bit PayloadLength versus explicitly supported32-bit jumbogram.
native.ip_ecn_mode: Actual transport support and packet ECN codepoint; no implicit transport congestion control.
native.ip_hbh_processing: Actual node processing policy under RFC9673; absence of processing does not mean packet rejection.
native.ip_source_address: Actual version-matching source address, scope/assignment requires actual interface evidence.
native.ip_destination_address: Actual version-matching destination, group/scope/delivery separate from address syntax.
native.ip_next_hop_address: Actual selected neighbor/route next hop; no automatic gateway IP.
native.ip_interface_binding: Actual canonical interface and registered lower technology path.
native.ip_lower_path_source: Actual frame/PHY/MTU/queue/arbitration/encapsulation evidence of selected lower path.
native.ip_address_source: Actual address/prefix/scope assignment, next hop, neighbor discovery and routing evidence.
native.ip_implementation_source: Actual host/router version and capabilities; RFC constant does not prove implementation.
native.ip_pmtu_source: Actual measured/configured path MTU, ICMP/PTB handling and selected probe policy.
native.ip_acceptance_source: Actual complete upper transport/application functional E2E/freshness/safety acceptance.
native.ip_jumbo_source: Actual source/destination/link jumbo support and full32-bit upper-layer lengths.
native.ip_fragment_source: Actual identifier lifetime, fragment coverage/order/overlap and reassembly evidence.
native.ip_options_source: Actual IPv4 options wire contents/padding/copy behavior, not assumed zero when options exist.
native.ip_extensions_source: Actual ordered extension headers including all first-fragment upper headers.
native.ip_ecn_source: Actual selected upper transport ECN capability/policy and incoming/outgoing packet handling.
native.ip_hbh_source: Actual Hop-by-Hop options and selected node processing implementation.
native.ip_tunnel_source: Actual inner/outer version, encapsulation overhead, lower MTU and fragmentation policy.
native.ip_prefix_bits: Actual address prefix, IPv4 max32 versus IPv6 max128.
native.ip_header_octets: Actual IPv4 IHL*4 with options versus IPv6 fixed40-byte base header.
native.ip_ihl_words: Actual IPv4 header length5..15 in32-bit words, not application payload.
native.ip_extension_octets: Actual aggregate IPv6 extension octets, included in PayloadLength.
native.ip_payload_octets: Actual current IP payload, includes upper-layer headers and IPv6 extensions.
native.ip_packet_octets: Actual current IP packet excluding lower-layer headers/trailer/padding.
native.ip_payload_length_field: Actual IPv6 16-bit wire length; zero for jumbogram.
native.ip_next_header: Actual immediately following IPv6 header number; not necessarily upper transport after extensions.
native.ip_protocol_number: Actual IPv4 upper protocol number, separate from transport ports.
native.ip_dscp: Actual6-bit DSCP, default PHB0 proposal without bandwidth/priority guarantee.
native.ip_ecn_bits: Actual2-bit ECN codepoint tied to packet ECN mode.
native.ip_traffic_class: Actual8-bit DS field =4*DSCP+ECN, IPv4/IPv6 header semantics.
native.ip_ttl: Actual IPv4 transmitted TTL1..255; configurable historically suggested64, not a milliseconds deadline.
native.ip_hop_limit: Actual IPv6 HopLimit0..255; destination accepts zero, forwarding cannot use zero.
native.ip_flow_label: Actual20-bit IPv6 flow label; no universal assigned label0.
native.ip_identification: Actual IPv4 ID16-bit or IPv6 fragment ID32-bit; not global packet sequence.
native.ip_fragment_offset_units: Actual13-bit fragment offset in8-octet units, not byte offset.
native.ip_fragment_data_octets: Actual fragmentable data in this fragment; non-final must be8-octet aligned.
native.ip_reassembled_octets: Actual reassembled IP datagram including its base header, peer capability required.
native.ip_ipv4_flags_reserved: Reserved IPv4 flag must be zero.
native.ip_header_checksum: Actual IPv4 header-only ones-complement16-bit checksum, no IPv6 base checksum.
native.ip_link_mtu_octets: Actual selected IP link MTU, IPv6 minimum1280 is a constraint, not a measured default.
native.ip_path_mtu_octets: Actual path MTU versus local link MTU; never equal by assumption.
native.ip_peer_reassembly_octets: Actual destination effective receive/reassembly limit, not guaranteed65535.
native.ip_reassembly_timeout_s: Actual reassembly timeout: IPv6 fixed60s, IPv4 RFC1122 recommends60..120s, independent from E2E deadline.
native.ip_forward_hops: Actual required forwarding count, not inferred from system label.
native.ip_hop_processing_bound_ms: Actual bounded per-hop processing/queuing, not zero by default.
native.ip_functional_bound_ms: Actual complete sensor-controller-actuator deadline, independent from hop/TTL/reassembly.
native.ip_dont_fragment: Actual IPv4 DF bit; no IPv6 DF field.
native.ip_fragment_header_present: Actual IPv6 fragment header presence, incompatible with jumbo option.
native.ip_jumbo_supported: Actual complete lower/peer jumbo support, not standard existence.
native.ip_pmtu_discovery: Actual enabled and supported path-MTU discovery, no assumed packet success.
native.ip_ecn_transport_capable: Actual upper transport ECN capability; IP DS bits do not create capability.
native.ip_flow_assignment_enabled: Actual IPv6 source flow label assignment enabled.
native.ip_no_fragment_overlap: Actual checked disjoint fragments; IPv6 overlap rejects full reassembly.
native.ip_first_fragment_headers_complete: Actual first fragment includes all extension and upper-layer headers.
native.payload_bytes: Actual upper-layer/application data, not IPv4 total length, IPv6 extension-inclusive payload or link MTU. Every selected header/fragment/jumbo layout requires independent exact encoding.

scope: Each declared IPv4/IPv6 parameter independently reviewed from primary RFCs: address family, header/extension/payload lengths, DSCP/ECN/flow label, TTL/hop limit, fragmentation/ID/reassembly, jumbo option and actual link/path/peer evidence. IP has no physical bitrate or automatic Ethernet/industry path.
not_certified: Relevant declared-parameter RFC sections downloaded/read/hash manifest; full normative errata/security/implementation conformance and runtime codecs not certified.

RFC1700 TTL64 is a historical suggested proposal only, not a universal current required value. IPv6 Ethernet1500 applies only to that selected bearer; link/path MTU1280 is a lower constraint rather than a proposed measured path.

Declared upper profile validation remains separate from configured lower layers. New stack_parameter_completeness and unverified_stack_layers explicitly report a conventional but unconfigured IP layer; all capacity/preflight consumers still require full path integration before delivery.

Actual address scope/subnet/neighbor/multicast group validity, exact option/extension/fragment coverage, reassembly buffer, ICMP/PMTU probes, complete IPv4/IPv6 codecs and identity encoding remain unverified.

Generic catalog overhead8/identity transport encoder must not be interpreted as IP header/wire arithmetic; actual headers are independently specified and MODEL_MISSING prevents a certified capacity claim.
No global packet65535 or IPv6 own header checksum; application transport, lower PHY/queues/tunnels, functional E2E/trace/safety remain separate evidence requirements. Production not delivered
